method: Pin free models with enable_routing:false. Byte-check full HTTP body / reassembled SSE for raw canaries + redaction markers. Literal canaries often short-circuit at input_scan (smart-mask / obfuscated_pii / data_leakage) before output guard. Where output guard ran, record http_status/request_id/stream/raw_present/markers. Tried alternate free models when first refused or 503'd.
